messages:
ceres: FYI customers reported failed SSO logins and some SCIM churn after the RBAC rule push at 02:00. Looks like entityID normalization + audience check combo caused fallback accounts.
rajan: Logs show: `SAML Assertion accepted` then `audience mismatch` on RBAC lookup, then SCIM created duplicate svc acct. Example: issuer=`https://idp.partner.com/App/XYZ` vs mapping key=`https://idp.partner.com/app/xyz`.
emma: When SCIM tried to reconcile it hit KMS decrypt failures. KMS logs show `DecryptDenied: context shape mismatch`. We introduced tenant and region into context last month.
kms-bot: KMS: 12 DecryptDenied events for key alias "prod/rekey-2026" during 02:03-02:10 window.
ceres: Quick mitigation: 1) add a temporary Identity mapping that normalizes case and trailing slash for partner apps, 2) allow a one-time legacy-context unwrap path gated to infra-admin and TTL 24h, 3) run a rewrap job to update envelopes to current context, 4) set backfill to `--no-deprovision`.
rajan: I'll add mapping in identity-service and roll to canary (2% first). infra-bot: canary deploy started -> 2% traffic -> observering auth flow.
emma: I'll prepare the rewrap tool: read envelope, attempt unwrap via legacy allowance, re-encrypt with current context, atomic swap. Dry-run on shard-5 with limit=100 first.
kms-bot: action_req: open vuln-triage if legacy unwraps > 0 and actor != infra-admin. Current count=2.
ceres: Also add regression tests for entityID canonicalization and audience checks in the SSO integration suite.
rajan: Rolling mapping fixed auth failures in canary. Error-rate on SSO auths dropped 3.6% -> 0.5%.
emma: Rewrap dry-run finished: 98/100 would rewrap successfully, 2 flagged for manual review. Scheduling safe rewrap window in 30m.
ceres: I'll file an incident and notify partner ops. Keep logs and audit pushed to sec-audit for the 02:00-03:00 window. Postmortem to decide whether KMS context should be strictly bound or allow stable migration helpers.
rajan: Will also add monitoring alert for future RBAC rule changes that affect entityID normalization.
ceres: Thanks team. Post updates in incident channel. :thumbsup:
